name: island
title: Island
description: A status pill that reshapes between states, Dynamic Island style: width and height move on one spring with round ends, the old content leaves as the new one enters part by part, and the spinner and the check that draws itself are functions of time. Screen readers get each state from a polite status region; nothing takes focus.
author: ARLing s. r. o. (https://arling.sk)

.am-island-detail.color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--am-island-fg, var(--primary-foreground, #fafafa)) 68%, var(--am-island-bg, var(--primary, #171717)))

docs:
Island from ARLing Motion (MIT).
React: import { Island } from "@/components/ui/motion-island".
The logic is in lib/arling-motion-island.js (typed by the .d.ts next to it) and works without React: createIsland on your own markup.
Styles were added to your global CSS under @layer components (Tailwind v4).
With Tailwind v3 or no Tailwind, add https://arling.sk/motion/components/island/island.css to your styles instead.
Live demo and docs: https://arling.sk/motion/#island
